name: Eliezer
bio: Eliezer of Damascus was the chief steward of Abram's household. Before Abram had a promised son, he once worried that his estate would pass to "Eliezer of Damascus" for lack of an heir (Genesis 15:2-3), but God promised him a son of his own body instead. Tradition commonly identifies Eliezer with the unnamed "eldest servant" in Genesis 24, sent by Abraham to find a wife for Isaac among his own people — faithfully carrying out his master's charge and earnestly praying for the LORD's guidance along the way, making him a model of a trustworthy servant in Scripture.
